# WHAT IS ON THE SHELF [italic]The standard stock. What is actually on the shelf today depends on the last freighter and the last bad shift.[/italic]
## PILL BOTTLES
- [bold]Red, Bicaridine[/bold]. Bruises and cuts. Free, one bottle a week. - [bold]Yellow, Kelotane[/bold]. Burns. Free, one bottle a week. - [bold]Green, Dylovene[/bold]. Toxins and bad air. Free, one bottle a week. - [bold]Blue, Dexalin[/bold]. Breathing. Ask at the counter. - [bold]Orange, Tricordrazine[/bold]. General first aid. Free.
One tablet at a time, and no more than two of the same kind in a short period. The label says so, and so do we.
## FIRST AID
- [bold]Gauze rolls[/bold], for cuts and bleeding. - [bold]Burn ointment[/bold], for burns once cooled. - [bold]First aid autoinjectors[/bold], one per worker on a remote shift. Sign for it.
## KITS
- [bold]General first aid kit[/bold], white. One per work crew, signed out by the crew lead. - [bold]Burn kit[/bold], for the galley, the welding bay and the processor. - [bold]Toxin kit[/bold], for the hydroponics bay, the refinery and anywhere chemicals are kept. - [bold]Oxygen kit[/bold], for anywhere the air can go bad. On some colonies that is everywhere.
## BEHIND THE COUNTER Painkillers, the emergency autoinjector and anything stronger are kept behind the counter and supplied on a prescription only. Please do not ask the counter staff to make an exception. They are not allowed to, and they get asked every day.
